finding: Same-ancestry opposite propositions could be hidden by max_per_ancestry despite sufficient total item budget.
semantic_change: Conflict representatives may bypass ancestry-family duplicate-support caps while still consuming the hard total item budget; they are marked CONFLICT_VISIBILITY and receive independent_replication_credit=false. Tight total budgets remain hard and omitted alternatives retain re-expansion references.
additional_preserved_concurrent_delta: Packet identity is content/provenance-bound; exact duplicate delivery is idempotent and same packet_id with different content fails closed.
limitation: The connected GitHub file surface was not mounted into the hosted Python runtime, so the regression execution recreated the committed algorithm semantics rather than importing the repository file byte-for-byte. GitHub content writes themselves are durable; target-Ubuntu execution remains required.
